title: Your New Hire Froze on Their First Rush

scenes.say: Day two. First rush. Theo froze.

scenes.speaker: Theo
scenes.say: Nobody showed me the milk station. I just stood there.
His first week should have looked like this. Day one, shadow someone. Day two, one station only. Day three, the slow afternoon on his own. Day five, his first rush, with backup.
So: never put a new hire on their first rush alone. Teach one station at a time. And pair them with one person all week.

props.title: Train week one
steps: No solo rush in week one
